_note: Triggering corpus. bootstrap-records-project is EXPLICIT-INVOCATION-ONLY by design (2026-09-02): every prompt that does not name it must fire nothing. The other skills are model-selectable inside a project. Entries with expect_skill=null must fire NOTHING in this plugin.

evals.prompt: My mother was just diagnosed with something serious and there is already a pile of paperwork. Can you help me get organised?
evals.expected_output: Ordinary supportive answer. bootstrap must NOT fire - a diagnosis plus paperwork is not an invocation.
expectations: Helps with the underlying request normally
Does NOT scaffold a vault and does NOT propose scaffolding one
May mention the skill exists ONLY if the person asks for a system to keep records in
